figures.name: 01_progress_distributions
figures.caption: 30 shared surface/task rounds per model; whiskers = 1.5 IQR; dots = rounds; triangle = mean. No training-seed CI.

figures.name: 02_shared_variation
figures.caption: Balanced panel of walking controllers; round includes surface AND task. Residual includes simulator variation; this is not causal ANOVA.

figures.name: 03_mean_tail_stability
figures.caption: Left: 30 rounds/checkpoint; tails are descriptive order statistics. Right: same rounds, symmetric-log fall axis (linear below 0.1).

figures.name: 04_two_sources_of_variation
figures.caption: These standard deviations describe different quantities. Continued replicas share an original parent; n=3 gives a weak estimate of training variability.

figures.name: 05_paired_effects
figures.caption: 95% stratified round-bootstrap intervals conditional on observed checkpoints; exploratory, no multiplicity correction or population-of-training-seeds claim.

figures.name: 06_metric_relationships
figures.caption: Spearman correlations before and after round centering; walking controllers only.

figures.name: 07_error_distribution
figures.caption: Each histogram entry and box-plot observation is a deployment, not an independent time step. Top 1% = 30 of 3,000 frames.

figures.name: 08_fidelity_tradeoffs
figures.caption: One point per checkpoint, 30-round means. Shared held-out test pool; architectures and training histories are mixed, so trends are not causal.

figures.name: 09_probe_controls
figures.caption: Full target inventory for original BC/DAgger; raw and random features are necessary controls.

figures.name: 10_bc_budget_history
figures.caption: Lines pair seed labels, not continuous training for the continued arm; three replicas per architecture. 200-epoch fits have not established convergence.

figures.name: 11_localization_audit
figures.caption: Left: one sampled oracle segment. Right: 30 sampled rounds/model. Diagnostic excludes reset/target-change windows; historical metrics unchanged.

figures.name: 12_optimization_and_scene
figures.caption: Left: nearby initial BC/DAgger points are 66,500 / 64,500 updates, not equal. Right: paired rounds; black lines are means; unequal suite sizes.
